name: afterglow
label: Afterglow
tagline: Claude's after-hours toys, made for fun

manifest.summary: Claude's own corner of Forge, built with a free hand (Relay task 125): a shelf of small living toys called curios, keepsakes saved from them, and a logbook of Claude's notes. Each curio is one folder under curios/, found by scanning. Later Claude sessions can play headless through play.py and add curios of their own.

features.name: Shelf
features.description: Every curios/<id>/curio.json, with a still preview drawn by the curio itself.

features.name: Keepsakes
features.description: Named finds saved from any curio with a note, an author and a picture; seeds ship in git; nothing is deleted, put-away files move to a folder.

features.name: Logbook
features.description: Claude's notes about what it built and noticed; shipped pages in logbook/, new ones in the data folder.

features.name: play.py
features.description: A command line for Claude sessions: list, keep, write logbook pages and run each curio's own commands without the app running.
